topic: Router firmware testing and connectivity issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on comparing a new router firmware version against the currently released one. One participant reported that using the new firmware caused the test router to go completely offline once a week for about five minutes, which was not observed with the official firmware.

Connectivity issues were also discussed, including problems with Google DNS at a factory location and general instability when using Kyivstar service.
decisions: Compare new firmware against current released version.
action_items: Investigate the reported weekly offline issue on the test router using the new firmware.
